cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Know the Procedure
cards.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll investigate the missing raffle tin. Naturally, we begin with access. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cleaner has the only cupboard key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. As expected. Where does our keyholder go after cleaning?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Reception. But the tin never went in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, we've eliminated that location. Confirm where you last saw it; I'll establish our next search area.

mechanism: A performs investigative command but borrows the keyholder and then last-sighting route from B, offering shared work while pretending correction is a planned elimination.
confusable: Unlike straightforward evidence testing without pretense, A presents new information as expected method; authority depends on B guiding the actual next step.
comparison: A missing raffle tin search differs from diagnosing a door while learning a staff member repair routine.
seedUse: D138-a cupboard key, cleaner and tin never stored there; S02-a recasts the direction and divides search/notes work.
